title: Overclocked
description: OverClocked is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack that maximizes FPS while adding lightweight Quality-of-Life improvements and optional visual polish.
body:
A high-performance Minecraft modpack focused on maximum FPS, smooth gameplay, and smart Quality-of-Life improvements.

vid...




### **Performance**

OverClocked is built to push Minecraft to its limits using modern optimization mods.
It significantly improves FPS, reduces stuttering, and speeds up loading times on both low-end and high-end systems.
All included performance mods are carefully selected to be safe for worlds and provide real, noticeable gains without breaking vanilla mechanics.

### **Visual enhancements**

OverClocked includes optional visual and graphical improvements that enhance clarity and polish without sacrificing performance.
Most bundled resource packs are non-essential and can be enabled or disabled freely, allowing players to balance visuals and FPS however they like.

### **Quality of Life**

Alongside performance boosts, OverClocked adds lightweight Quality-of-Life features that make Minecraft feel smoother and more modern, while keeping gameplay familiar and vanilla-friendly.

### **Works everywhere**
OverClocked does not include content-changing mods, meaning it works on:

1. Singleplayer worlds
   
2. Vanilla servers
   
3. SMPs and PvP servers
 
No server-side installation is required.

### **Always up to date**
OverClocked aims to stay up-to-date with new Minecraft versions whenever possible.
Updates are designed to be simple and preserve your existing settings where supported.

### **Built on Fabric**

OverClocked uses the Fabric mod loader, known for its lightweight design, speed, and massive mod ecosystem.
You can easily use this modpack as a base and add your own favorite Fabric mods.

### **Community-driven**
User [FeedBack](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdv5mdOznlzvBM3K7uNIviiw1OYql5fGUX2YuDn1nsgQMfSQ/viewform?usp=header) matters. OverClocked is shaped by player suggestions, bug reports, and performance feedback to ensure the best experience possible.

### **FAQ**

Q: How do I install or update OverClocked?

A: Install it through supported launchers such as Modrinth App, Lunar Client, or Prism Launcher.

Q: Will this modpack work on servers?

A: Yes. OverClocked works on all servers that allow vanilla clients. No server mods required.

Q: Does this replace OptiFine?

A: OverClocked supports many OptiFine-like features such as shaders, zoom, and connected textures through modern alternatives.

Q: My game crashed or something feels wrong. What should I do?

A: [Report issues or bugs through our issue tracker so they can be fixed quickly.](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdv5mdOznlzvBM3K7uNIviiw1OYql5fGUX2YuDn1nsgQMfSQ/viewform?usp=header)

Q: Can I add my own mods?

A: Yes! OverClocked is designed to be modular and works great as a base modpack.

Q: I have more questions or suggestions.

A: Share your [FeedBack](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdv5mdOznlzvBM3K7uNIviiw1OYql5fGUX2YuDn1nsgQMfSQ/viewform?usp=header) we'd always like to hear it!
